channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: How Trump Is Wielding Power to Stifle Speech
item.description: President Trump has harnessed agencies across the government to curtail press freedoms, a sweeping campaign that free speech advocates say will have lasting effects.

item.title: NPR: 'People are still afraid of those three letters': Fighting the stigma of HIV
item.description: That's a quote from former rugby star Gareth Thomas, who is HIV positive. At the International AIDS Conference in Rio this year, he spoke out about the isolation and discrimination tied to the virus.

item.title: BBC News: Reform receives second £36m donation in two days as crypto investor matches record
item.description: Christopher Harborne says he has equalled a donation from Ben Delo - the single largest gift to a UK political party.

item.title: The Guardian: Naomi Klein: ‘Extreme wealth has a deranging effect. It turns you into a supremacist’
item.description: She’s tackled neoliberalism and the digital world, now the writer and activist is taking on tech billionaires. She explains how the super-rich are capitalising on climate and financial chaos in pursuit of power Naomi Kle…

item.title: Al Jazeera: India’s Modi calls for empowerment of Global South at BRICS Summit
item.description: India’s Prime Minister Narendra Modi has called for an overhaul of global governance.

item.title: Ars Technica: I spent $4,000 on a robot dog from China
item.description: Unitree might be the world’s most important robotics company.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: How 9/11 Made Everyone a Conspiracy Theorist
item.description: Crackpot theories were once the stuff of shortwave radio, but September 11 unleashed the Age of Alex Jones.

item.title: WIRED Science: ‘I’m Really Terrified’: A Mathematician Grapples With AI’s Recent Breakthroughs
item.description: Steven Strogatz coauthored a book about how math is moving beyond human understanding. He spoke with WIRED about the seismic impact artificial intelligence has had on his life’s work.

item.title: WIRED Business: The US Government Launched 3 Previously Unreported Investigations of Polymarket Trades
item.description: The agency that oversees prediction markets has investigated Polymarket trades on Biden pardons and the Iran war—and even more potential insider trading at Google, documents obtained by WIRED show.

item.title: The New Yorker: The U.S. Was Never Going to Win the “War on Terror”
item.description: In the twenty-five years since 9/11, the U.S. has waged several military campaigns against extremism around the world, resulting in the deaths of almost a million people. What has it accomplished?

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: What Do Kids Want Us to Talk About With Them?
item.description: A family’s relationship to conversation is a fundamental component of its private culture.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: A Bristol-Myers Factory in Clinton Hill Converted by Artists
item.description: Behind the simple façade on Greene Avenue, the vast, column-free floors go back 90 feet and are full of original details.

item.title: Fox59: 17-year-old shot, killed in Columbus shooting
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ind. — A 17-year-old is dead after a shooting in Columbus on Friday evening. According to the Columbus Police Department, around 6:30 p.m., first responders were called to the 3200 block of Country Brook Street…

item.title: Mirror Indy: Hoosiers use an abortion fund to bypass the state’s ban
item.description: Patients often use the money to travel out of state to Illinois. The post Hoosiers use an abortion fund to bypass the state’s ban appeared first on Mirror Indy .
